title: Agent harness: fake every tool the loop can call (list_cards, visible_cards, GIF tools, mark, quote, cancel, global memory)
description: Follow-up to MPI-1129. services/agentBench.mjs fakeTools lacks listCards, visibleCards, markCard, makeGif/editGif/cutoutGif/gifToVideo/makeSheet, quoteGeneration, cancelGeneration, readGlobalMemory/writeGlobalMemory, openFlow/openPrompt. A model that reaches one gets TOOL_ERROR 'is not a function' instead of the app's answer (the failing MPI-1129 room run called list_cards and visible_cards before STEP_LIMIT). Add fakes answering the way the connector routes do, plus a test that every unguarded this._tools.X in agentLoop.mjs exists in fakeTools. Low priority.
